environment.tool: scripts/probes/rce/row.py sweep 2026-11-18 (control-first, exact request bytes, executing peer)

findings.description: Driven by scripts/probes/rce/row.py against the tagged release. Observed: control 200, upstream saw ['GET /api/x?a%0d%0aGET%20/exec%3fcmd=id%0d%0aHost:%20u%0d%0a%20HTTP/1.1 HTTP/1.1']. Root cause at `61cc738c:67` (`proxy`, raw target into the line).
findings.title: request_line_split: verified upstream-side RCE (high)

findings.description: Driven by scripts/probes/rce/row.py against the tagged release. Observed: control 200, upstream saw ['POST /api/x HTTP/1.1', 'GET /api/exec?cmd=id HTTP/1.1']. Root cause at `61cc738c:67` (`proxy`), `:68` (`serve` passes `true`) - `Connection: content-length` strips the CL.
findings.title: body_replay_desync: verified upstream-side RCE (high)
